data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Rollback delete_issue must tolerate 404 / NotFoundError as terminal-success — do NOT consume RETRY_BUDGET; only transient errors (network, 5xx, rate-limit) retry. Add test: _outbound_create raises post-create + delete_issue raises NotFoundError on first call → rollback returns cleanly + original create exception is the one surfaced (not rollback exhaustion). Rationale: avoids false-positive rollback-exhaustion alerts on partial-create-then-already-gone scenarios (missing_error_path).
